data.narrative:
Beyond Aero, a Series A transportation company founded by Eloa Guillotin, Hugo Tarlé, and Valentin Chomel, has raised $44M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a broader transportation sector peer set of 8 private companies—including Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, Pipedream, and FleetZero—though no direct public comparables exist in this subsector.

The Stage-Progression method is the primary applicable triangulation approach. Using total capital raised ($44M) as a baseline proxy and applying a typical 2.0x step-up multiplier for progression from Series A to subsequent rounds, this method implies a valuation of $88M. The Peer-Median method was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow transportation peer set; while 8 private companies operate in the sector, fewer than three meet the filtering criteria for direct peer comparison, making a sector-wide median unreliable.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $75M (low) to $101M (high), with a median estimate of $88M. This range reflects reliance on a single methodological anchor, creating material dependency on the accuracy of the 2.0x step-up assumption for this stage and subsector. Key uncertainties include the absence of public market pricing signals and limited private comparables with disclosed terms, both of which constrain confidence in the implied multiple.
